notes.title: New game announcement.
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]unfortunately, as you may have guessed, the development of Daedalus has now been halted due to internal team reasons, however the original developer from our team is embarking on a new solo journey. [/p][p] [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I4cuqsV2LHU"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]If you’re interested in following his next project, a PSX-style horror game, you can do so here:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4015860/Too_Many_Bots/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thanks for following.[/p]

notes.title: We know, that was impossible!!!
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We are pleased to announce that as we work to introduce new and exciting features, we have fixed some issues. 

Here are the corrections made in this latest version, 0.6.1a:
[list]
[*][b]Fixed the issue of different jigsaw puzzles in multiplayer:[/b] You should no longer experience the situation where two players saw different jigsaw puzzles during multiplayer matches.
[*][b]Improved the arrow puzzle:[/b] We have also fixed the problem of impossible combinations in the arrow puzzle.
[*][b]Minor fixes[/b]
[/list]
Please continue to follow us for further updates and new features coming in the near future. Thank you for your ongoing support and for being a part of our community of players.

Join our discord:
[url=https://discord.gg/CKFjSnKMyZ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44189152/f45d6713976113a8504e6f6ab1b0ee5a50846b86.png[/img][/url]
   
You'll never escape the maze,

The Daedalus Team.

notes.title: The more, the better
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Here we are with another update, coming so soon after the last one. We have added a new puzzle, but this time it's different because it has a significant impact on gameplay. This new puzzle has been exclusively designed for the cooperative mode, which means you can only play it with your friends and work together to solve it.

Here's the version [b]0.5.0a[/b] changelog:
[list]
[*]Added puzzle playable exclusively in cooperative mode.
[*]Minor bug fixes.
[/list]
Join our discord:
[url=https://discord.gg/CKFjSnKMyZ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44189152/f45d6713976113a8504e6f6ab1b0ee5a50846b86.png[/img][/url]
   
You'll never escape the maze,
The Daedalus Team.

notes.title: Nobody dies forever
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
In this update, we have added a new game mechanic that significantly affects the player experience in cooperative mode: you now have the chance to bring a victim of the maze to life (it's up to you to discover how:). This new mechanic also serves as the foundation for new features that we will be implementing, and it's a great way to let you know how excited we are for our participation in the Steam Scream Festival.

Here's the version 0.4.15a changelog:
[list]
[*]Dead players can now be revived.
[*]A new puzzle has been added.
[*]Minor bug fixes.
[/list]
Join our discord:
[url=https://discord.gg/CKFjSnKMyZ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44189152/f45d6713976113a8504e6f6ab1b0ee5a50846b86.png[/img][/url]

You'll never escape the maze,
The Daedalus Team.

notes.title: Version 0.4.12a Live
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We've just added some quality settings to the options menu, which are now also accessible in-game, to enhance performance on mid-range and low-end computers.

Changelog for version 0.4.12a:
[list]
[*]You can now adjust the depth of field quality.
[*]You can now modify fog quality.
[*]In-game options menu is now available.
[*]minor bug fixing
[/list]
[b]Note:[/b] this update is also available for the demo.

Stay tuned for more updates. 

You'll never want to leave the maze.

The Daedalus Team.

notes.title: Version 0.4.8a live
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
We have just released a new version with some important changes. 
Here's the log:
[list]
[*]Networking code improved (lag removed).
[*]The player no longer slides while moving around.
[*]Female character added.
[*]New puzzle added.
[*]Option menu added (not in-game yet).
[*]Lighting enhanced.
[*]The ragdoll improved upon player death.
[*]The difficulty of some puzzles has been balanced.
[*]Music and sound effects improved.
[/list]
    
The major improvement involves the netcode for sure: some players had a hard time trying to move across the labyrinth due to network lag, so we took some time to figure out how to fix this issue... and we did it: player movement is now much smoother and responsive.

We are exited to announce our partecipation in the Steam Scream Festival, and we are working on adding a brand-new feature to the gameplay.

Stay tuned,
the Daedalus team.

notes.title: Private alpha is ready
notes.notes:
Hello, 
here's an important update on the game's progress. We have replaced some puzzles that didn't seem intriguing enough with mini-games that make the gameplay much more interesting in our opinion: we truly believe that we have taken the right path when it comes to puzzle design, and we will certainly continue in this direction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44189152/5d4940aff761acb44e9546e6545d3510832bfefe.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44189152/30474fd08ec4bcabf8055b41f84fa6fda1f51670.jpg[/img]

In the meantime, we have performed numerous tests on the game's multiplayer system (which currently only supports up to two players but will expand to four in the future), which also gave us the chance to work on game balancing, especially considering the various difficulty levels we already planned to introduce later, and to fix some bugs.

Given the progress we have made so far, we feel [b]it is time to release a private alpha build[/b] for influencers, press and anyone who would like to participate in the beta testing program (for more information and Steam keys, please visit our [url=https://discord.gg/CKFjSnKMyZ]Discord[/url] channel). For everyone else, we will soon be releasing a public demo (also in alpha version).

[url=https://discord.gg/CKFjSnKMyZ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44189152/f45d6713976113a8504e6f6ab1b0ee5a50846b86.png[/img][/url]

Thank you all for your support, and we'll see you in the labyrinth :)

notes.title: Testing multiplayer.
notes.notes:
Just a little update.

We are conducting depth tests on the 2-player online multiplayer mode, and we are very close to uploading a stable alpha version on Steam. The alpha will not be publicly available yet, meaning there won't be early access. It will only be accessible to press, streamers, and beta testers: join us on discord to learn more.

[url=https://discord.gg/CKFjSnKMyZ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44189152/f45d6713976113a8504e6f6ab1b0ee5a50846b86.png[/img][/url]

A shared gaming experience is always more fun, say cheese :)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44189152/1742635ac4c079ee980bf15d8847cd0d35d10a24.png[/img]

We don't have a definitive roadmap yet, but we would like to share some ideas to let you know what you can expect in the game:

[list]
[*]You will find many random puzzles designed as mini-games to make them more interactive and enjoyable.
[*]Players will have the ability to revive fallen teammates using specific potions that can be obtained during the game.
[*]Random power-ups will appear in the game, including various items such as energy drinks and invisibility cloaks.
[*]Daedalus coins (obtainable by escaping the maze, not quitting :) ) will allow you to acquire enhanced power-ups.
[*]We are considering increasing the number of players to 4, but this requires a solid testing base for 2-player matches.
[/list]
    
This is me, Pierpiero, the developer, playing together with David, our concept artist.
[previewyoutube=Vvl_5jE0R24;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks from the Daedalus team :)
